key_insight: Physics-informed neural networks discover strongly nonlinear water waves with near-machine-precision equation residuals, followed by rigorous residual certification and machine-checked verification for one candidate.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers an auditable route from AI-generated wave computations to certified equation-residual bounds for nonlinear free-surface flow modeling.
method: Learn periodic wave profiles, speeds and selected surface tensions directly from governing equations without training data.
Use staged training, refinement and continuation to recover known wave families and discover new candidates.
Certify one finite representation using interval arithmetic, then verify deductions from certified bounds in Lean.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports recovery of Stokes waves, Crapper waves and Wilton ripples, plus a certified uniform residual bound for one candidate accounting for roundoff, Fourier truncation, aliasing and grid-to-continuum errors.
watch_item: Certification covers one candidate’s equation residual; it does not by itself establish proximity to an exact solution or certify every discovered wave.
paper_title: Rigorously Certified Neural-Network Computation of Nonlinear Water Waves at Near-Machine Precision
